author: hdprajwal
abstract: Writes a detailed, bite-sized implementation plan from a spec — exact files, exact code, exact commands, TDD steps, frequent commits — assuming the executing engineer has zero context. Maps the file structure first, decomposes into 2-5 minute steps, bans placeholders, self-reviews against the spec, then hands off to executing-plans or subagent-driven-development. Adapted from obra/superpowers' writing-plans skill. Tuned to hdprajwal's actual workflow (branch → PR → merge loop, specs in docs/, pnpm + cargo, runtime-proof verification, short plain prose) based on usage analysis.
